raw_text: ALERT: Sophisticated PLC-targeting malware discovered in Indian chemical plant ICS network. Targets Siemens S7-300/400 controllers. Code analysis reveals Stuxnet-like capabilities for process manipulation. This is a highly targeted attack on industrial control systems. Malware modifies setpoints for temperature and pressure control loops. Potentially catastrophic if undetected.
clean_text: Sophisticated PLC malware found in Indian chemical plant targeting Siemens S7-300/400. Stuxnet-like process manipulation capabilities. Modifies temperature and pressure setpoints.
